name: ゼルニケモーメント分析
description: 使用します rotation-invariant Zernike moments as descriptors for detecting duplicated and manipulated image regions.
algorithm: Zernike Moment-Based Block Matching for Copy-Move Detection
mechanism: Computes complex Zernike moments for image blocks, providing rotation-invariant descriptors. Matching blocks with similar moment vectors 識別する duplicated regions even after geometric transformations.
parameters: Order: up to 12, ブロックサイズ: 16×16, Matching: Euclidean distance, 閾値: 適応型
source: Ryu, S.J. et al. (2013) — Rotation Invariant Localization of Duplicated Image Regions Based on Zernike Moments, IEEE TIFS
useCase: 回転やスケーリング変換に対してロバストなコピームーブ偽造の検出

references.title: Ryu, S.J. et al. (2013) — Rotation Invariant Localization of Duplicated Image Regions Based on Zernike Moments, IEEE TIFS

strengths:
• Rotation invariant 検出
• Handles scaled copies
• Mathematically rigorous descriptors
• Works on complex textures
limitations:
• 計算コストが高い moment calculation
• High-order moments sensitive to noise
• Block size affects 感度
• Memory intensive for large images
